response.text: [turn 3] The anomaly ALR-0003 and maintenance record MW-0001 fully explain the 2-hour outage of S-SFX-001 between 03:00 and 05:00 as a scheduled battery swap (T1, T5). Since the cause is a completed planned maintenance window, no escalation is necessary.
